title: zornia lanata
intro: Zornia lanata, commonly known as White Buttonweed, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Zornia lanata are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and display anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. Bioactive constituents of Zornia lanata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
